input.brief: Write a two-sentence reply thanking the organizer and declining Friday's invitation. Do not ask a question. Keep it under 60 words. Do not invent a reason I cannot attend.
input.original:
I appreciate the invitation.
I cannot attend on Friday.
input.draft: Thanks for the invitation! I can’t make it on Friday.
